join_sequence: Authenticate both distinct actual parent invocations, successful full original completion and immutable custody. Preserve both original driver bytes unchanged; receipt status alone is insufficient.
Require source/engine/inventory/base/upstream/relative input/anchor/scientific argv equality; physical cold roots and parent invocation identities must differ.
Validate each producer receipt has original mode and complete original science/custody/phase records; native has real native_calls and original cold build/finite controls; pure has null native_calls.
Read all six exact artifacts from each sealed lane, verify their parent file bindings and corresponding receipt/science hashes. Reject absent, stale, aliased, changed or partial files.
Require all six raw byte equalities and full complement raw byte equality. No G12 extra target fixture or epoch candidate data enters either lane or this join.
Validate complete typed full-return canonical schema and fixed role/rank/trace domains on both lanes. Require schema-exact equality with no bool-as-int or mutable cross-lane/candidate aliases.
Construct fresh pure-owned role/rank/trace projections and pure raw bytes tuple, plus fresh native-owned exact counter dict. Expose exactly the five reference members only after the complete join.

Bind this fresh projection to the actual P02 root/control handle and invocation through an independently reviewed fixed source bridge. Every absent proof keeps None; no arbitrary callback or flag enables the current driver.

parent_binding_fields.actual_child_argv: actual immutable complete argv vector including mode, output, frozen-root, reference, anchor; recorded by source-owned spawn/return wrapper
parent_binding_fields.actual_working_directory: actual execution directory bound before child start and after return
parent_binding_fields.anchor_binding: actual anchor raw bytes SHA256 plus successful source-owned original anchor provenance and original driver equality; not a new profile sample
parent_binding_fields.artifacts: ordered tuple of six (relative name, exact immutable raw bytes, byte count, observed SHA256, identity/custody binding); no omitted member
parent_binding_fields.complement: actual raw complement-transcript.json bytes with corresponding identity/custody binding
parent_binding_fields.complete_parent_stdout_stderr: actual retained raw outer process streams, including original receipt stdout tail; parent must observe completion after original full_driver:348-352
parent_binding_fields.consumed: exact one-use parent-to-consumer transfer, no candidate writable alias
parent_binding_fields.guard_result: actual outer full-cost wall/CPU/RSS/resource result, never receipt status or a source-only budget inference
parent_binding_fields.invocation_id: fresh parent-owned one-use identity, not receipt status
parent_binding_fields.lane: exact str baseline or candidate, paired respectively pure/native
parent_binding_fields.normal_exit: actual independently observed normal exit code exactly 0, no signal, timeout, kill, cancellation, guard failure or pending child
parent_binding_fields.output_custody: seal all required regular files after successful exit and revalidate same identity/content before transfer; reject symlink, stale, partial, aliased or changed custody
parent_binding_fields.output_root: fresh canonical separate output root, lstat/device/inode/mode ownership record and cold-generation nonce
parent_binding_fields.parent_source_binding: exact root-owned parent function/code/global/default/closure identity and source SHA256
parent_binding_fields.receipt_binding: actual receipt.json bytes and file identity, mode/source/engine/inventory/original checks/science binding verified
parent_binding_fields.schema: fixed source-owned parent completion schema, exact version to be independently implemented
parent_binding_fields.scientific_input: Same pinned 32-file inventory, H=25 and original relative paths; exact script argv [fresh_runtime/scripts/complex_network.py].

reference_native_counters.pure_native_calls: Pure baseline native_calls must remain null; never substitute it or epoch candidate counters.

reference_outputs.candidate_projection: Exact same six relative paths under the actual epoch output root; read after original checks and before data_finalization. No serialization of candidate values into references.
reference_outputs.join: All six complete native artifact bytes must equal corresponding pure bytes first. No hash-only substitute or omitted member.
reference_outputs.python_type: builtin tuple of exactly six builtin bytes values

reference_rank_events.copy_policy: Restore all tuple boundaries lost only by original JSON array serialization; no sorting, deduplication or suffix-only transcript.
reference_rank_events.json_domain: list of pairs [rows, rank], rows is list of exact ints; rank exact int, never bool; no unknown members or arbitrary tags

native_shape_source.source_fact: Original native gram_rank constructs tuple-of-int rows and an int rank, returns a pair tuple. Text inspected only; no native operation.

reference_rank_events.python_type: fresh builtin list of builtin tuple pairs, each (tuple(exact int rows), exact int rank), in full original event order

reference_role_result.selector: unique typed top-level dict pair whose key is [str, role_frames]
reference_role_result.values: Decode actual pure values. Do not hard-code scientific results; native complete typed artifact must match byte-for-byte.

reference_trace.native_equality: Raw entire complement-transcript.json bytes equal, plus decoded complete field equality; no digest subtraction.

COMPLEMENT_EXPECTED.schema: v2-jsonl:call,us,vs,result(type=list+values or type=None); ordered exact integer vectors

allowed_exact_tags.Fraction: [Fraction, exact int numerator, exact positive int denominator] reduced original rational
allowed_exact_tags.dict: [dict, ordered unique recursively typed key/value pair list]

typed_full_return_grammar.canonical_json: json.dumps with sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=True as original; no trailing newline for full-return.lossless.json
rejections: duplicate decoded dict key, even if tags differ
partial subtree accepted as complete return
typed_full_return_grammar.root: exact list tag dict with ordered unique key-value pairs; entire source-produced root retained and round-tripped byte-for-byte
